decode.scroll_stop_trick: The same limb cut open twice: on the left the cross-section is packed with yellow fat around a shrunken muscle, on the right it is lean muscle — the buyer sees inside her own body.
decode.angle_carried: 'lose fat, not definition' (muscle preservation while cutting)
decode.hidden_reading: none — pure anatomy; the authority of a textbook drawing
decode.scene_logic: no scene; a medical plate on a beige page — ours is the same plate, lower leg instead of upper arm, because her problem is inside the calf and ankle
decode.visual_trick: two cross-sections side by side with a thin vertical divider; the 'bad' tissue is yellow and lumpy, the 'good' tissue is clean red/pink — copy literally: left calf swollen, skin stretched, tissue pale and water-logged with yellowish fluid pockets between the muscle and the skin; right calf slim, skin close to the muscle, tissue clean, same pose, same cut line
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: fatty cross-section of an upper arm ↔ fluid-logged cross-section of a lower leg (calf + ankle); the arm's bent elbow ↔ the ankle bend
decode.structure_type: split (two states, one body part, divider in the middle)
decode.render_style: flat medical illustration, soft pastel skin, beige #f3efe9 background, no outlines
decode.text_treatment: bold black sans headers top, italic in the tagline ('Not Definition' italic), black rounded button with white text, small grey footnote, small logo bottom centre

strategy.angle: A8-L heavy, swollen legs — 'lose the fluid, not more weight'
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: told to lose weight again · cause: inflamed tissue holding fluid under the skin · tried: dieting harder for years
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
